{{DISPLAYTITLE:PRINT}}
{{QBDLDATE:2024-01-01}}
{{QBDLTIME:00:00:00}}
The '''PRINT''' statement writes text to the screen.

{{PageSyntax}}
{{CodeStart}}
PRINT [{{Parameter|expression}}]
{{CodeEnd}}

{{PageDescription}}
* {{Parameter|expression}} is any string or numeric expression.
* A trailing {{InlineCode}};{{InlineCodeEnd}} suppresses the newline.

{{PageExamples}}
{{CodeStart}}
PRINT "Hello"
{{CodeEnd}}

{{PageSeeAlso}}
* {{Cl|PRINT USING}}
